No. FIRMS recorded no thermal detections intersecting this property (ASSET-F07) between 26 September and 26 October 2026.

All four sensors covered the whole period without gaps: VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21 and MODIS. The run's rule was that every day must be covered by each sensor to count as covered, so the zero result is not caused by missing data.

Some caveats:
- A detection counted only if its footprint intersected the asset. Fires just outside the boundary would not appear in this result.
- The data are near real time, so they could be revised later.
- The asset's area is not given in the metadata, so I can't say how large the property is relative to the sensors' pixel sizes. Small or short-lived fires can go undetected by satellites.
